description: This file defines the `MerchantStoreService` interface, which extends a generic service interface to include methods related to retrieving and saving merchant store data in the sales management system.

classes.name: MerchantStoreService
classes.description: Interface defining service operations for MerchantStore entities, including retrieval by code and save/update functionality.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Retrieves a MerchantStore based on its string code.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a MerchantStore using an alternative code identifier.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new MerchantStore or updates an existing one.
